== Notes ==
*The % chance to halve skill recharge [[Effect stacking|stacks]] with other sources (e.g. from weapon mod), but the skill recharge is still capped at half. At max rank, with a 40/40 weapon set, this amounts to a 74% chance to halve spell recharge.
*The halve skill recharge applies to the reduced recharge time for Mesmer spells due to [[Fast Casting]] in PvE.
